canonical_project: Telenor Svalbard Longyearbyen headquarters and data center
notes: Telenor press release says the rebuilt Longyearbyen office and data center was taken into use in March 2022, has rooftop solar producing up to 30-33 kW peak and up to 30000 kWh/year, and uses data center waste heat for the office building. No IT load/MW capacity disclosed.
